items.title: Inflation and government borrowing highest for a year ahead of next week's Budget
items.summary: Inflation accelerated to 3.5% from 3.1% in the year to September, according to the Office for National Statistics (ONS).

items.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
items.summary: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

items.title: US envoy Steve Witkoff thanks Vladimir Putin for diesel deal at Ukraine talks in Russia
items.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff is in Saint Petersburg, holding talks with Russian president Vladimir Putin. The face to face meeting comes after he met with Ukraine's president and other European leaders in Oslo. Witkoff is due to return to the Norwegian capital after his visit to Russia
